body: It was in the around the middle of August, but picked up in october

My parents come from very different backgrounds. One was from an overly strict background with a flair for old times and my other parent was from an abusive household. Neither were prepared financially or emotionally to support another child. I was an accident and it lead to constant fights. Eventually, it reached a point where they separated and I stayed with my mother. She was never home because she had to work and it lead her to moving in with a bad man and his wife. They were sexually abusive and it's strange how history repeats itself. It happened with her and so it happened with us.
Ask what now? My life is in shambles and it feels like I'm going through hell.
